Game Overview

In The Flappy Bird, the core idea is straightforward: guide your bird through the skies, dodging enemy flocks with each precise tap. Chase high scores as you navigate this endless flight, but beware—one misstep could bring you crashing down. Can you master the balance between altitude and speed in this captivating aerial adventure?

How to Play

The Flappy Bird keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Guide your bird through the skies, dodging enemy flocks with each precise tap.
